meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

copy.tagline: 查询单细胞和空间转录组学数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要编程查询大规模单细胞和空间转录组学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Query single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data programmatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically query large-scale single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.

howto.what: Claude 可以编程式查询 CZ CELLxGENE Census 中的公开单细胞和空间转录组数据，包括细胞元数据、基因表达切片、总结计数、源 H5AD 链接、嵌入和空间数据。支持跨物种、组织、疾病等过滤。
howto.when: 当用户需要查询公开的单细胞表达数据（如按细胞类型、组织、疾病过滤）或获取 Census 总结信息时触发。

say.text: 查询人类大脑中B细胞的基因表达数据。
say.note: Claude 会执行 get_anndata 并返回结果。

say.text: 获取2025-11-08版Census中肺组织的总细胞数。
say.note: Claude 会读取 summary 信息并返回计数。

say.text: 比较人类和小鼠的CD4表达差异。
say.note: Claude 会分别查询两个物种的数据并对比。

howto.what_en: Claude can programmatically query the CZ CELLxGENE Census for public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, including cell metadata, gene expression slices, summary counts, source H5AD URIs, embeddings, and spatial data. Supports filtering by organism, tissue, disease, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to query public single-cell expression data (e.g., filtered by cell type, tissue, disease) or retrieve Census summary statistics.

say_en.text: Query gene expression of B cells in human brain.
say_en.note: Claude runs get_anndata and returns result.

say_en.text: Get total cell count for lung tissue in 2025-11-08 Census.
say_en.note: Claude reads summary info and returns count.

say_en.text: Compare CD4 expression between human and mouse.
say_en.note: Claude queries both species and compares.
